map.圆锥体积为何是圆柱的 1/3？: Why is a cone one third of a cylinder?
map.可由积分或祖暅原理证明：同底同高的圆锥与圆柱，前者体积恰为后者三分之一。工程中估: It follows from integration or Cavalieri's principle: for equal base and height the cone is exactly one third of the cylinder. In engineering you simply divide by 3 when estimating hopper contents.
